sources.usage: Project brief, enums, allowed design space, ranges, and schemas.
Public/cleared/provisional source usability registry; distinguishes formal-ready, background-only, provisional-only, and needs-review materials.
Agent-readable navigation layer for scopes, required tasks, source-use boundaries, and missing-data checklist; not a new authority source.
Three required detailed-design key area boundaries (provisional).
Official announcement tasks, scope levels, key areas, language, and deliverable context.
Agent-facing open-call principles, six required agent tasks, scenario/branding/operation requirements, and boundary clause.
Tero A. et al. (2010) Rules for biologically inspired adaptive network design, Science 327(5964): 439-442. Methodological basis for the bio-Physarum adaptive network.
Deb K. et al. (2002) A fast and elitist multiobjective genetic algorithm: NSGA-II, IEEE TEVC 6(2): 182-197. Optimization method for the four-objective network renewal problem.

Author's real Physarum + NSGA-II run (167-edge network, optimal efficiency 19.20, heritage objective f3≡f2 [degenerates to cost; no independent site heritage conclusion], Plan03 UDS 80.34). Method-validation evidence only; located ~2-3 km west of the provisional boundary, so not entered as formal geometry. Recorded as metric values in metrics.json and as narrative in proposal.md, not as a geometry layer.
sources.note: Run artifacts are not committed as geometry; the coordinate offset makes direct spatial reuse invalid for this site.
